description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' that renders the top navigation bar, including a hamburger menu, branding, and optional theme toggle. It manages menu open/close state, accessibility features, and navigation actions through props and internal logic.

methods.name: navigateSchedule
methods.description: Handles navigation to the schedule route, either via provided callback or by updating window.location.hash.

methods.name: navigateHome
methods.description: Handles navigation to the home route, either via provided callback or by updating window.location.hash.

methods.name: onHamburgerKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events on the hamburger button to open menu with arrow down key.
